coverage_rule: Transcribed rows = every official-page row with a Did-Not-Participate or Limited practice status, any game status, or any quarterback row. Rows listed Full Participation with no game status (bench players) are omitted; the full official list is at the official page.
note: All rows transcribed from the official NFL.com league-wide injury report page (fetched 2026-11-13) and labelled VERIFIED. Rows with Full Participation and no game status are omitted per the coverage rule; the official page holds the complete list. The committed nflverse mirror (research/nfl/raw/injuries_2026.csv.gz) was used only as a cross-check and lags the official page (e.g., zero Rams rows in the mirror snapshot).
